name: Cooper's Restaurant (Fish Haven, ID) Morning Eggs Breakfast or Grilled Fish & Steak
brandOrRestaurant: Cooper's Restaurant & Sports Bar (Bear Lake West · Fish Haven, ID)
whyItWorks: Overlooking the Idaho side of Bear Lake, Cooper's serves classic two-egg breakfasts with toast/potatoes and simple grilled fish or steaks at dinner.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order scrambled or poached eggs with sourdough toast and bacon/ham at breakfast, or plain grilled fish/steak with baked/mashed potato at dinner.
watchOuts: Ask for no lemon butter on fish to keep it citrus-free
